d: We are looking for an Emirati with a Bachelor's degree in Law to join a leading financial services organization as an AML Officer. This is an exciting opportunity to build a career in financial crime prevention, AML compliance, and regulatory governance within a dynamic professional environment.

The role offers excellent exposure to AML/CFT frameworks, regulatory requirements, customer due diligence, and compliance monitoring, making it an ideal opportunity for law graduates looking to develop their expertise and grow within the financial services sector.
q: Bachelor's degree in Law is mandatory.
0–3 years of experience in AML, compliance, legal, financial services, or a related field.
Fresh graduates with a strong interest in AML and compliance are welcome to apply.
Basic understanding of AML/CFT regulations, compliance principles, and financial crime prevention.
Strong analytical, research, and attention-to-detail skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Arabic is preferred.
High level of integrity, confidentiality, and professionalism.
r: Monitor transactions and activities to identify potential suspicious transactions and financial crime risks.
Support AML/CFT compliance monitoring and ensure adherence to applicable regulatory requirements.
Review customer onboarding, KYC documentation, and customer due diligence processes.
Assist with enhanced due diligence (EDD) for high-risk customers and business relationships.
Support the preparation and submission of Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) and other regulatory reports, where applicable.
Maintain AML records, compliance documentation, and monitoring reports.
Assist in updating AML policies, procedures, and internal controls in line with regulatory developments.
Conduct AML awareness and compliance training for employees.
Coordinate with internal teams on AML-related matters and support regulatory audits and inspections.

q: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Engineering or related discipline .
12+ years of FP&A / financial performance experience , including senior leadership responsibilities.
Strong upstream Oil & Gas / E&P experience is essential.
Good understanding of the E&P lifecycle, including exploration, development, production and decommissioning .
Experience with JV/JOA, PSCs, WP&B, AFEs, cash calls and cost recovery .
Strong experience in budgeting, forecasting, petroleum economics, financial modelling and management reporting .
Experience with SAP S/4HANA, SAC Planning, Power BI or similar tools is preferred.
Professional qualification such as CFA, CPA, ACCA, CIMA or CA is preferred.
Fluent English and willingness to travel internationally.

In simple terms: The ideal candidate is a senior FP&A leader with strong upstream Oil & Gas experience, who understands both corporate financial planning and the commercial/economic side of E&P operations.
r: Lead company-wide financial planning, budgeting and forecasting .
Manage long-term financial plans, monthly forecasts and performance reporting.
Provide financial analysis and insights to support senior management and shareholder decisions.
Review and challenge country and asset-level budgets, forecasts, CAPEX and OPEX.
Support petroleum economics, production and reserves planning, scenario modelling and investment decisions .
Oversee FP&A reporting, KPIs, financial data and management information.
Drive Finance digitalisation, analytics and automation, including SAP and BI solutions.
Lead and develop the FP&A and Digital Finance team.

d: Amana Healthcare, brought to you by M42 and Mumtalakat, is pleased to announce the first Amana Healthcare facility in Bahrain, located in Al Jasra. This world-class hospital will provide long-term care and post-acute rehabilitation services.

M42 delivers comprehensive healthcare services across the full continuum of care; from primary care to advanced specialty treatments. Leveraging cutting-edge health technologies and precision medicine, we ensure the highest standards of effectiveness, efficiency, and patient-centered outcomes. With a global presence spanning more than 480 facilities in 27 countries and a dedicated workforce of over 20,000 professionals, M42 is uniquely positioned to redefine the future of healthcare on a global scale.
Coordinate and monitor quality improvement initiatives across departments to ensure compliance with organisational quality standards and regulatory requirements.
Conduct regular quality audits, inspections, and compliance reviews and support departments in implementing corrective and preventive actions.
Collect, analyse, and report quality indicators, KPIs, and performance metrics to identify trends and opportunities for improvement.
Manage incident reporting, risk assessments, and root cause analyses, ensuring timely investigation and follow-up of identified issues.
Support accreditation and regulatory compliance activities, including preparation for surveys, audits, and inspections.
Develop, review, and maintain quality-related policies, procedures, and documentation to ensure alignment with best practices and regulatory standards.
Coordinate staff education and awareness programmes on quality, patient safety, infection control, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Collaborate with clinical and non-clinical departments to promote a culture of quality, patient safety, and operational excellence throughout the organisation.
q: Bachelor's Degree in Healthcare Administration, Nursing, Allied Health, Quality Management, or a related healthcare field.
Minimum 2 to 4 years of experience in healthcare quality, accreditation, patient safety, or clinical operations.
Knowledge of healthcare quality standards, accreditation requirements, and regulatory guidelines (e.g., NHRA, JCI, CARF, CBAHI, or equivalent).
Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
Commitment to continuous improvement and patient-centred care.
Ability to drive compliance and foster a culture of quality and safety.
